relationships.evidence: PACT explicitly states that Methodology v3 is the foundation for Technical Specifications v3.
PACT v3 builds on leading GHG accounting standards including the GHG Protocol Product Standard.
relationships.constraints: Requirements are not identical and are under revision.

relationships.evidence: Both are product-carbon methods for supply chains; Catena-X adds automotive/ecosystem rules.
relationships.validation_question: Compare current clauses and accepted deviations.

relationships.evidence: TfS and PACT publish a joint guide explaining methodological and technical differences.
relationships.constraints: The methods are not interchangeable without reconciliation.
relationships.validation_question: Use the joint guide as a maintained crosswalk.

relationships.evidence: PACT v3 requires reporting the IPCC characterization-factor assessment version and points to AR6 as latest.
relationships.constraints: Time horizon/report version must be explicit.
